CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_SearchBigAndSmallForAutoScheduling]
(
	@YearID	 int = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null	
)
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- Xử lý thêm, lớp liên quan là lớp tách ghép trong ma trận Reference hoặc là có lịch theo năm
	Select ClassID 
	Into #tblSchedule
	From SIM_Schedule 
	where YearID = @YearID		
	Group by ClassID
	
	---2026.08.24 -- thêm lịch thi 
	Select ClassID 
	Into #tblTestschedule 
	From Sim_Testschedule 
	where YearID = @YearID		
	Group by ClassID
	

	
	-- Big class
	Select BigClassID as "ClassID",
			ClassID as "OriginClassID",
			0 "GroupSmallClass",
			-1  "ClassIndex", -1  "OriginClassIndex" 
	From SIM_Class_Subject 
	where BigClassID is not null and BigClassID <>''		
		And ( YearID = @YearID -- năm đang tìm hoặc là lớp ghép có lịch, lịch thi
				or BigClassID in (Select ClassID from #tblSchedule)
				or Bigclassid in (Select ClassID from #tblTestschedule)
			)
		and (@ClassID is null or ClassID = @ClassID)		
	group by BigClassID, ClassID
	
	UNION

	-- small class		   
	Select a.ClassID as "ClassID",
			b.ClassID as "OriginClassID",
			GroupSmallClass,
		-1  "ClassIndex", -1  "OriginClassIndex" 
	From SIM_Class a 
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject b on a.ClassSubjectID = b.ClassSubjectID  
	Where ClassType = 2 
		And ( b.YearID = @YearID -- năm đang tìm hoặc là lớp tách có lịch trong năm, lịch thi
				or a.ClassID in (Select ClassID from #tblSchedule)
				or a.ClassID in (Select ClassID from #tblTestschedule)
			)
		and (@ClassID is null or b.ClassID = @ClassID)		
	Group by a.ClassID, b.ClassID, GroupSmallClass
		
END

		[Day],

		[FinishTime],

		[FinishLession],

		Left join SIM_Teacher as teacher2 on tbl.TeacherID2 = teacher2.TeacherID
		Left join SIM_Teacher as teacher3 on tbl.TeacherID3 = teacher3.TeacherID

		and (@ToDate is null or tbl.Date <= @ToDate)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_Search]
( 
	@ClassSubjectID bigint = null,
	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null,
	@Semester tinyint = null,
	@YearID int = null,
	@BigClassID nvarchar(50) = null,	
	@ClassSubjectStatus int = null, -- 0:binh thuong,1:bi ghep, 2: bi tach, 3:cua lop ghep, 4: cua lop tach, 5:tru cac dong 1,2 ra
	@SubjectID nvarchar(50)= NULL,
	@IsOnlyForScheduling bit = null		
)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT
		convert(bit,0) as "IsSelected",
		0 [Order],
		tbl.[ClassSubjectID],		
		[YearID],
		ltrim(str(YearID)) + ' - ' + ltrim(str(YearID+1)) "YearText", -- khong nen left vao se chap nen tu tinh the nay
		[Semester],
		tbl.[ClassID],
		tbl.[SubjectID],		
		SubjectName,
		SubjectShortName,
		SubjectType,
		tbl.[UnitText],
		
		tbl.[TheoryQuantity],
		tbl.[PracticeQuantity],	
		tbl.TestQuantity,
		
		isnull(tbl.[TheoryQuantity],0)  + isnull(tbl.[PracticeQuantity],0) + ISNULL(tbl.TestQuantity,0) as Quantity,			
		
		CONVERT(BIT,tbl.DoneQuantity) "IsDone", -- đã học
		tbl.DoneQuantity, -- số tiết đã học
		[TeachingBy],
		SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName +' ' + dbo.SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName as TeachingName, --GV day

/*
	NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT		04/04/2011
	Trạng thái Môn học lớp, để xem bao tiết cần phân, đã phân bao nhiêu, ai dạy
*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_Class_Subject_Status]
(
	@ClassID nvarchar(50),
	@Semester tinyint = null,
	@YearID int,
	@Week int = null,
	@ListClassID nvarchar(3000) = null -- danh sach ma lop theo kieu select like
)
AS   
BEGIN

	SELECT top 50 ---- LOP HOC PHAN 				
		[SubjectID],				
		[UnitText],
		[TheoryQuantity],
		[PracticeQuantity]															
	Into #table1
	FROM [SIM_Class_Subject]
	Where 
		YearID = @YearID
		and (@Semester is null or Semester = @Semester)
		and ClassID = @ClassID	
			

	Select top 50
		SubjectID, 
		sum(case when IsPractice = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as RealTheoryQuantity,
		sum(case when IsPractice = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as RealPracticeQuantity,
		sum(case when IsPractice = 0 and Week = @Week then 1 else 0 end) as RealTheoryQuantityWeek,
		sum(case when IsPractice = 1 and Week = @Week then 1 else 0 end) as RealPracticeQuantityWeek			
	Into #table2
	From SIM_Schedule 
		Inner join SIM_ReferenceClass ON SIM_ReferenceClass.ReferenceClassID = SIM_Schedule.ClassID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.ClassID = @ClassID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.YearID = SIM_Schedule.YearID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.Semester = SIM_Schedule.Semester
	Where	
		SIM_Schedule.YearID = @YearID
		and (@Semester is null or SIM_Schedule.Semester = @Semester)
	Group by SubjectID
	
	Select top 50
		SubjectID, 
		sum(case when IsPractice = 0 then Quantity else 0 end) as TheoryQuantityWeek,
		sum(case when IsPractice = 1 then Quantity else 0 end) as PracticeQuantityWeek
	Into #table3
	From SIM_WeekDetailPlan 
		Inner join SIM_Class_Subject on SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID = SIM_WeekDetailPlan.ClassSubjectID			
		Inner join SIM_ReferenceClass ON SIM_ReferenceClass.ReferenceClassID = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.ClassID = @ClassID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.YearID = SIM_Class_Subject.YearID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.Semester = SIM_Class_Subject.Semester
	Where	
		SIM_Class_Subject.YearID = @YearID
		and (@Semester is null or SIM_Class_Subject.Semester = @Semester)
		and (@Week is null or Week = @Week)
	Group by SubjectID

	Select top 50
		SubjectID, 
		TeacherID
	Into #table4
	From SIM_Schedule 
		Inner join SIM_ReferenceClass ON SIM_ReferenceClass.ReferenceClassID = SIM_Schedule.ClassID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.ClassID = @ClassID
			AND SIM_ReferenceClass.YearID = @YearID
	Where	
		SIM_Schedule.YearID = @YearID
		and (@Semester is null or SIM_Schedule.Semester = @Semester)		
	Group by SubjectID, TeacherID
		

	-------------------------------------------------------
	SELECT top 50
		0 as [Order],		
		table1.[SubjectID],	
		SubjectShortName,
		SubjectName,		
		table1.[UnitText],
		case when SubjectType = 0 then	table1.[TheoryQuantity] + isnull(TestQuantity,0) -- mon tich hợp thì vừa có LT vừa TH
			 when SubjectType = 1 then table1.[TheoryQuantity] + ROUND(table1.[PracticeQuantity] * dbo.SIM_Subject.PracticeQuantityRatio,0) + isnull(TestQuantity,0) -- môn LT thì cộng dồn vào
			 else 0
		end TheoryQuantity, 

		case when SubjectType = 0 then	ROUND(table1.[PracticeQuantity] * dbo.SIM_Subject.PracticeQuantityRatio,0)
			 when SubjectType = 2 then table1.[TheoryQuantity] + ROUND(table1.[PracticeQuantity] * dbo.SIM_Subject.PracticeQuantityRatio,0)+ isnull(TestQuantity,0)
			 else 0
		end PracticeQuantity, 

		isnull(RealTheoryQuantity,0) RealTheoryQuantity,
		isnull(RealPracticeQuantity,0) RealPracticeQuantity,
		isnull(RealTheoryQuantityWeek,0) RealTheoryQuantityWeek,
		isnull(RealPracticeQuantityWeek,0) RealPracticeQuantityWeek,
		TeacherFirstName + ' ' + TeacherLastName as FullName,	

		isnull(TheoryQuantityWeek,0) TheoryQuantityWeek,
		isnull(PracticeQuantityWeek,0) PracticeQuantityWeek

  
	FROM #table1 table1	
	-- LICH HOC DA PHAN CA KI	
	Left join #table2 table2 on table1.SubjectID = table2.SubjectID

CREATE PROC [dbo].[SCA_Sign_SearchFor_USignArea]

	@DocSerial nvarchar(50) = null, -- mã duy nhất của đối tượng văn bản

	--Set @LoginName = 'administrator'

	-- 1. Từ mẫu văn bản ta lấy ds vị trí cần ký số
	Select *
	Into #tblPosition
	From SCA_DocForm_SignPosition
	Where DocFormID = @DocFormID
	Order by OrderIndex

	
	-- 2. Tìm văn bản theo DocForm và DocSerial (nếu có) -- chỉ có 0 or 1 dòng duy nhất cho mỗi bản thẻ hiện văn bản
	Select top 1  -- dùng top 1 cho chắc thôi

		IsAttachFile,

		and IsDeleted = 0 -- bỏ dữ liệu đã xóa
	
	

	-- 3. Tìm dữ liệu ký số của văn bản (nếu có)
	Select	
		SCA_Sign.*
	Into #tblSign
	From #tblDoc tblDoc
		Inner join SCA_Sign on SCA_Sign.DocID = tblDoc.DocID
	Where SCA_Sign.IsDeleted = 0 -- ko lấy xóa

	-- 4. Tạo bảng dữ liệu ký số đầy đủ theo ds vị trí kí số, còn chữ ký nếu chưa có thì rỗng
	Select 
			tblPos.SignPositionID, -- vị trí cần ký

			tblDoc.*, -- Văn bản đã tạo (duy nhất nếu có)

	From #tblPosition as tblPos
		Left join #tblDoc as tblDoc on  1 = 1 -- do có 1 doc nên chỗ này ko cần điều kiện
		Left join #tblSign as tblSign on tblSign.SignPositionID = tblPos.SignPositionID
	Where

			or tblPos.IsActived = 1 -- hoặc vị trí ký đang kích hoạt
		)

	Drop table #tblPosition
	Drop table #tblSign

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_WeekDetailPlan_GetListWeek]
(
	@Semester TINYINT = NULL,
	@YearID INT,
	@ListClassID NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
	@IsInPlan BIT = 1, -- lấy từ kế hoạch tuần
	@IsInSchedule BIT = 1 -- lấy từ TKB
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF @IsInPlan IS NULL SET @IsInPlan = 1;
	IF @IsInSchedule IS NULL SET @IsInSchedule = 1;

	-- Lấy ngày bắt đầu năm học
	DECLARE @Date DATETIME;
	SELECT @Date = StartAt FROM SIM_Year WHERE YearID = @YearID;

	-- Tính ngày hiện tại
	DECLARE @Today DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);

	-- Lấy danh sách các tuần
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[Week]
	INTO #tblWeek
	FROM (
		-- lấy từ kế hoạch tuần
		SELECT [Week]
		FROM SIM_Class_Subject CS
		LEFT JOIN SIM_Subject S ON S.SubjectID = CS.SubjectID
		LEFT JOIN SIM_Class C ON C.ClassID = CS.ClassID
		LEFT JOIN SIM_WeekDetailPlan WDP ON WDP.ClassSubjectID = CS.ClassSubjectID
		WHERE
			@IsInPlan = 1
			AND (@Semester IS NULL OR CS.Semester = @Semester)
			AND CS.YearID = @YearID
			AND C.IsActived = 1
			AND (@ListClassID IS NULL OR @ListClassID = '' OR @ListClassID LIKE N'%'+ CS.ClassID +'%')
			AND [Week] IS NOT NULL

		UNION

		-- lấy từ lịch đã sắp
		SELECT [Week]
		FROM SIM_Schedule
		WHERE
			@IsInSchedule = 1
			AND (@Semester IS NULL OR Semester = @Semester)
			AND YearID = @YearID
			AND (@ListClassID IS NULL OR @ListClassID = '' OR @ListClassID LIKE N'%' + ClassID + '%')
			AND [Week] IS NOT NULL
	) AS WeekSource;

		--- Main select 
	SELECT 
		CONVERT(INT, W.[Week]) AS [Week],
		LTRIM(STR(W.[Week]+1)) AS WeekTitle,
		LTRIM(STR(W.[Week]+1)) + ' (' + 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), DATEADD(DAY, W.[Week]*7, @Date), 103) + ' - ' + 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), DATEADD(DAY, W.[Week]*7+6, @Date), 103) + ')' AS WeekTitle2,
		
		-- Tính cột để sắp xếp
		CASE 
			WHEN @Today BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY, W.[Week]*7, @Date) AND DATEADD(DAY, W.[Week]*7+6, @Date) THEN 0
			ELSE 1
		END AS PrioritySort
	FROM #tblWeek W
	GROUP BY W.[Week]
	ORDER BY PrioritySort, W.[Week]

	DROP TABLE #tblWeek;
END

Create Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Class_SearchBigAndSmallForAutoScheduling]

	@ClassID nvarchar(50) = null

Begin
	Select ClassID
	Into #tblSchedule
	From SIM_Schedule
	Where YearID = @YearID
	Group By ClassID
	---2026.08.24 -- thêm lịch thi
	Select ClassID
	Into #tblTestschedule
	From Sim_Testschedule

		And (YearID = @YearID
			Or BigClassID in (Select ClassID From #tblSchedule)
			Or Bigclassid in (Select ClassID From #tblTestschedule)
		)
		And (@ClassID is null Or ClassID = @ClassID)
	Group By BigClassID, ClassID
	Union
	-- small class
	Select a.ClassID as "ClassID",
		b.ClassID as "OriginClassID",
		GroupSmallClass,
		-1 "ClassIndex", -1 "OriginClassIndex"
	From SIM_Class a
		Inner Join SIM_Class_Subject b On a.ClassSubjectID = b.ClassSubjectID
	Where ClassType = 2
		And (b.YearID = @YearID

		And (@ClassID is null Or b.ClassID = @ClassID)

/*
	GET DANH SÁCH TUẦN CHO MỘT NIÊN, MỘT HỌC KÌ
	Created By: NGUYỄN VĂN VIỆT 31/12/2010
*/
Create Procedure [dbo].[SIM_WeekDetailPlan_GetListWeek]
(
	@Semester tinyint = null,
	@YearID int,
	@ListClassID nvarchar(500) = null,
	@IsInPlan bit = 1,
	@IsInSchedule bit = 1
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On;
	If @IsInPlan Is Null Set @IsInPlan = 1;
	If @IsInSchedule Is Null Set @IsInSchedule = 1;
	Declare @Date datetime;
	Select @Date = StartAt From SIM_Year Where YearID = @YearID;
	Declare @Today date = Cast(GetDate() As date);
	Select Distinct
		[Week]
	Into #tblWeek
	From (
		Select [Week]
		From SIM_Class_Subject CS
			Left Join SIM_Subject S On S.SubjectID = CS.SubjectID
			Left Join SIM_Class C On C.ClassID = CS.ClassID
			Left Join SIM_WeekDetailPlan WDP On WDP.ClassSubjectID = CS.ClassSubjectID
		Where @IsInPlan = 1
			And (@Semester Is Null Or CS.Semester = @Semester)
			And CS.YearID = @YearID
			And C.IsActived = 1
			And (@ListClassID Is Null Or @ListClassID = '' Or @ListClassID Like N'%' + CS.ClassID + '%')
			And [Week] Is Not Null
		Union
		Select [Week]
		From SIM_Schedule
		Where @IsInSchedule = 1
			And (@Semester Is Null Or Semester = @Semester)
			And YearID = @YearID
			And (@ListClassID Is Null Or @ListClassID = '' Or @ListClassID Like N'%' + ClassID + '%')
			And [Week] Is Not Null
	) As WeekSource;
	Select
		Convert(int, W.[Week]) As [Week],
		Ltrim(Str(W.[Week] + 1)) As WeekTitle,
		Ltrim(Str(W.[Week] + 1)) + ' (' +
			Convert(varchar(5), Dateadd(Day, W.[Week] * 7, @Date), 103) + ' - ' +
			Convert(varchar(5), Dateadd(Day, W.[Week] * 7 + 6, @Date), 103) + ')' As WeekTitle2,
		Case
			When @Today Between Dateadd(Day, W.[Week] * 7, @Date) And Dateadd(Day, W.[Week] * 7 + 6, @Date) Then 0
			Else 1
		End As PrioritySort
	From #tblWeek W
	Group By W.[Week]
	Order By PrioritySort, W.[Week]
	Drop Table #tblWeek;
End
Go
